description: Official I-JEPA algorithm adapted to the same ImageNet-100 images, ViT-S/16, 240px, batch64 and 100 epochs. This is not the published ImageNet-1K recipe or an equal-FLOP comparison.
differences_from_sepa: Official patch-level multiblock prediction, target LayerNorm and Smooth L1 loss.
Official 6-layer/384-width predictor, larger than SEPA's 2-layer/192-width predictor.
Official RandomResizedCrop scale 0.3-1.0, bilinear; no flip, color jitter or blur.
Official weight-decay exclusions and cosine schedule 0.04 to 0.4; linear EMA 0.996 to 1; no gradient clipping.
Peak LR, warmup fraction, batch, image IDs and epoch count matched to SEPA; this single run does not establish optimal I-JEPA hyperparameters.
Official bf16 autocast, FP32 parameters; final feature extraction and probes FP32. SEPA pretraining was FP32.
Manifest data adapter keeps the final short batch, deterministic per-image augmentation and per-batch masks; rejects overlap if the upstream sampler relaxes its constraint.

Final evaluation reuses SEPA's center-square bicubic resize, train-only feature standardization and frozen SGD LR0.005/200-epoch classifier. No official-validation-based checkpoint or hyperparameter selection.
